race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
race.verdict: Lots with chances but AVIATRICE took this prize a year ago and is fancied to repeat the feat on the back of an excellent second here last time. Multiple course winner Carolina Jetstream heads the list of dangers, although a solid case can also be made for Suzie Songs , Leading Dancer and Prevalence . AVIATRICE (IRE) CAROLINA JETSTREAM SUZIE SONGS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Dancing Saxon (10/3), Suzie Songs (7/2), Leading Dancer (9/2), Aviatrice (6/1), Prevalence (8/1), Quiescent (8/1), Callianassa (12/1), Carolina Jetstream (12/1), Josh's Joy (12/1), White Sand Beach (20/1), Wynette (20/1), Never Let Go (20/1), Pink Oxalis (25/1), Wearing Stars (33/1), Mallavelly (33/1), Duchess Of Kenli (33/1), Temperance (150/1)
